question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The erroneously spelt word is '**Aqurarium**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the given Options the incorrectly spelt word is '**Aqurarium**'.
 
• Its correct spelling is '**Aquarium**'.
 
• It means 'a glass container filled with water, in which fish and water animals are kept'. (पानी से भरी शीशे की टंकी जिसमें मछली आदि जलजीवों को रखा जाता है; मछलीघर, जलजीवशाला)
 
 
• *Example: The **aquarium** has some interesting specimens of unusual tropical fish.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Aqurarium.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Honorarium**: a payment made for somebody’s professional services, when no particular amount is charged for those services. [व्यवसायिक सेवाओं के लिए दी गई अदायगी जिसके लिए कोई निश्‍चित राशि (प्रभारस्वरूप) नहीं ली जाती है; मानदेय]
 
• **Boutique**: a small shop that sells fashionable clothes or expensive presents. (छोटी दुकान जहाँ लोकप्रिय कपड़े या महँगे उपहार बिकते हैं; बुटीक)
 
• **Bungalow**: a house that is all on one level, without stairs. (एक-मंज़िला मकान; बंगला)
